saved mask comes from C5, which loads the baseline and target arrays that C3 saved to /tmp. It builds per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day index windows (the daily series is contiguous), applies the wrapped 31-day smoothing, and compares the target days 2008-06-01 to 2008-08-31 against it; the target needs smoothed days 153–244, which draw on pool days 138–259, i.e. baseline dates May 12 to Sep 20 of each year. Per-cell runs of at least 5 hot days, with gaps of up to 2 days joined, are then written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
